name: Identity Documents
description: Identity documents issued to a person, including driving licences, passports, national IDs and state IDs. One record per issuance holds normalized fields and links to scans, extraction attempts and reviews.
captureExamples: Save the expiry date from my driving licence.
Record my passport number exactly as printed.
I renewed my national ID. Save the new issuance.

capture.identity: Match a selected issuance using kind, issuer and the reviewed document number. A renewal can have a new number or validity period. Ask before replacing a prior issuance when the match is ambiguous.
exclude: Vehicle plate and registration details describe the vehicle. Signed credentials and presentations belong in Credentials.
A photo alone supplies evidence. Record user review separately from issuer verification.
capture.workflow: Link source scans, retain extraction attempts, and record review/corrections before treating fields as reviewed.

notes: Use document for every government ID held by a person. documentType distinguishes passports, driving licences, national IDs and state IDs. fields.documentNumber is the printed identifier. fields.holder and fields.issuer describe the person and issuing body. Keep identifiers as strings.

Only a driving licence may carry fields.drivingPrivileges, with the category, dates and restrictions as issued. Only a passport may carry fields.passportTypeCode. Country-specific details stay optional, enabling partial capture from chat.

The holder, issuer, document number and dates can be mapped from the corresponding claims and document_details in the [OpenID Identity Assurance Schema Definition](https://openid.net/specs/openid-ida-verified-claims-1_0.html). This field mapping conveys no verification or trust-framework result.

An extraction stores the original input references, time, extractor and observed fields. A review records the user’s decision and corrections. Apply approved changes to the document separately. Keep each attempt and decision so other apps can explain where a field came from.
